description: IoT Village at DEF CON 26 covers IoT security vulnerabilities, firmware hacking, and device exploitation. The 11 talks explore attacks on smart home devices, medical implants, wireless speakers, smart locks, FPGAs, door locks, irrigation systems, and the legal landscape of IoT security research.
